title: SharePoint: Page Agent creates and refines SharePoint pages from Copilot chat
summary: Hold: the after-rollout checklist says Microsoft has not published the status, although the roadmap explicitly reports In development. The roadmap details and the existing agent-blocking path and API are supported; searches did not establish Page Agent-specific licensing, defaults or controls.
